sn34.6:1.4: bhikkhave yvāyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo ca.
sn34.6:1.5: ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca pāmokkho ca
sn34.6:1.6: uttamo ca pavaro ca. seyyathāpi bhikkhave gavā khīraṃ …pe… pavaro cāti. sāvatthī.
sn34.6:1.7: cattārome bhikkhave jhāyī. katame cattāro. idha bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo
sn34.6:1.8: hoti na samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo. idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo. idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī neva samādhismiṃ
